subject: math

hotspots.label: Numerator
hotspots.description: The numerator is the top number — the count of parts you have.
hotspots.positionHint: The lit '3' above the fraction bar in the 3/4 plate.

hotspots.label: Filled segments
hotspots.description: The filled segments are the parts the numerator counts — 3 lit segments for the numerator 3.
hotspots.positionHint: The lit segments inside the fraction bar.
hotspots.function: Show the equal parts counted by the numerator.

hotspots.label: Denominator
hotspots.description: The denominator (bottom) stays fixed while the numerator changes — it names the part size.
hotspots.positionHint: The '4' below the fraction bar, unlit.
hotspots.function: Names the equal parts; stays fixed here.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A single clean fraction bar split into segments with a fill slider and a fraction plate. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (coral / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Fraction bar: warm paper white with thin ink-grey segment seams (roughness ~0.5). Filled segments: warm amber fill (roughness ~0.45). Fraction plate: warm paper with ink 'n/d' text where the numerator is highlighted. Slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the numerator of a fraction, isolated — a fraction bar split into equal segments where only the lit (filled) count changes.

GEOMETRY: Fraction bar: thin rounded slab (length ~2.4, width ~0.3) at origin, y ≈ 0.25, split into 4 segments by thin seams. Filled segments are warm amber; empty ones stay paper white. Fill slider at the front (y ≈ −0.2) adjusts numerator 0..4 with denominator fixed at 4. Fraction plate floats above-left showing 'n/4' with the numerator lit.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) segment seams; (2) filled segments; (3) fraction plate with numerator/denominator badges.

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames bar and plate; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: FractionBar, Segments, Seams, FilledFill, Slider_Knob, FractionPlate, NumeratorBadge, DenominatorBadge. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
